title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page opens Section III, 'Calculs dans Gl(2,Ẑ)' et dans Gl(2,Ẑ)'. It is p. 396 of the manuscript numbering and p. 193 of the archive file.

Setting from the preceding pages:
- An element x of the group M_{0,3}^{!~} is a Galois / Grothendieck–Teichmüller-type automorphism of the relevant profinite Teichmüller tower.
- Earlier pages attached to x invariants in a profinite group Π_{0,3}^: (53) f, g, h, α0, β0, α, β, ξ, η.
- α0 and α lie only in the extension Π_{0,3}^{~^} ≅ Π_{0,3}^·{1, τ0}, where τ0 is an orientation-reversing involution.
- The previous page showed that these invariants behave as (twisted) cocycles in x.
- It also noted that f, α, β are defined only up to l0^n. A canonical choice would require a gerbe extending M_{0,3}^{!~} by Ẑ, modelled on the 'special Teichmüller gerbes'.

What this page does:
- Grothendieck pushes all the invariants into a linear quotient, Gl(2,Ẑ)' := Gl(2,Ẑ)/{±1}. The natural reading is through Π_{0,3}^ → SL(2,Ẑ)/±1 (a completed PSL(2,ℤ) / (1,1)-Teichmüller group modulo its centre), with τ0 mapping to a matrix of determinant −1.
- The images of f, g, h, β0, β, ξ, η lie in Sl(2,Ẑ)' = Sl(2,Ẑ)/±1 (56).
- α0 and α have determinant ε3 ∈ {±1} (54). Here ε3 ≡ μ mod 3, where μ ∈ Ẑ^× is the cyclotomic character of x (55).
- This is consistent with the previous page, where α0, α ∈ Π_{0,3} exactly when μ ≡ 1 (3). It reflects the fact that the order-3 generator is sent to a conjugate of its μ-th power, and μ mod 3 ∈ {±1}.
- Since det(−1) = 1 in dimension 2, det factors through Gl(2,Ẑ)'. This gives the exact sequence (57): 1 → Sl(2,Ẑ)' → Gl(2,Ẑ)' → Ẑ^× → 1.
- He then lifts f, α0, β0 to genuine matrices in Gl(2,Ẑ) (58). This amounts to a choice of three signs.

Where it leads (next page):
- The remaining quantities are defined from these lifts, e.g. ξ = αρ(α)^{-1}, α0 = f^{-1}α, g = f^{-1}ξρ(f).
- ξ, η, g, h are independent of the sign choices.
- The 'relation des lacets' becomes the matrix identity ξ = ε η h^ν. Its sign ε = ε2 is determined by μ ≡ ε2 mod 4.

Purpose: test the profinite 'équation des lacets' (the GT-type hexagon/pentagon-like relations) by computing its linear shadow in GL2(Ẑ). There the residual information reduces to signs governed by μ mod 3 and μ mod 4.
errors: No mathematical error. The exact sequence (57) is correct: det is surjective GL2(Ẑ) → Ẑ^×, with kernel SL2(Ẑ), and −I has determinant 1.
Notational slip: 'Gl(2,Ẑ)^{±1}' for the home of α0, α should read Gl(2,Ẑ)' (elements of determinant ±1 in Gl(2,Ẑ)').
Minor: (58) lists f, α0, β0 in Gl(2,Ẑ); f and β0 actually have lifts in Sl(2,Ẑ). Either way the lift is determined up to a sign, so 'trois signes' is correct.

ideas.what: Projection of the GT/Galois invariants (f, g, h, α, β, ξ, η) of an automorphism of the profinite Teichmüller tower to PGL2(Ẑ) = GL2(Ẑ)/±1, i.e. a 'linearized' shadow of the équation des lacets.
ideas.modern_name: Image of GT / G_Q in Out of profinite PSL2(Z) or SL2(Z); abelianized (linear) GT relations
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ihara, Drinfeld; Lochak–Schneps; Nakamura (explicit formulae for the action on profinite SL2(Z) / M_{1,1})
ideas.where_published: Not in Esquisse or La Longue Marche in this explicit matrix form (unsure)

ideas.what: det α = μ mod 3 ∈ {±1}: the determinant sign of the τ0-component is the cyclotomic character mod 3.
ideas.modern_name: Cyclotomic character acting on the order-3 torsion of PSL2(Ẑ) (Z/2 * Z/3)

missed.claim: The canonical normalization of f, α, β is left open. On the previous page Grothendieck proposes a gerbe, an extension of M_{0,3}^{!~} by Ẑ modelled on the special Teichmüller gerbes, on which they would be defined unambiguously. Here he instead resorts to the ad hoc choice of three signs. That gerbe construction is not carried out.
missed.quote: On choisira des représentants f, α0, β0 ∈ Gl(2,Ẑ) ce qui équivaut au choix de trois signes
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only a minor gap. A canonical torsor/gerbe-level normalization of GT-cocycles relates to existing work on GT torsors and Teichmüller groupoids (Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura). Probably not new.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine set-up: it projects the invariants to GL2(Ẑ)/±1, records determinants via μ mod 3, and states the trivial exact sequence. The interesting content (the matrix lacets relation with sign ε2 ≡ μ mod 4) is on the next page and matches known computations of the GT action on profinite SL2(Z).
transcription_corrections: (55): the character is written μ (as on the neighbouring pages: μ ≡ 1 (3), μ ≡ ε2 (4)), not χ: 'ε3 ≡ μ (3)'.
The opening line reads approximately 'Pour x ∈ M_{0,3}^{!~} donné, d'où les quantités'.
